chunks: And among what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Miskān, from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Should I advance some rakʿahs on Friday? He said: Yes, six rakʿahs. I said: Which of the two is more excellent: that I advance the rakʿahs on Friday, or that I perform them after the obligatory prayer? He said: Performing them after the obligatory prayer is more excellent.

So these two reports do not contradict what we presented and said was more excellent, because the proper way regarding them is that we understand them to mean that when the sun has passed the meridian, delaying the nawāfil is more excellent than advancing them. Advancing is only more excellent so long as the sun has not passed the meridian and the time of the obligatory prayer has not entered; for when it has passed the meridian, one should begin with the obligatory prayer on this day rather than the nawāfil. And that which indicates this is:

key_terms.النَّوَافِلِ: supererogatory prayers performed in addition to the obligatory prayer
key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory prayer whose priority is under discussion
key_terms.تَأْخِيرُ: delaying the nawāfil until after the obligatory prayer
key_terms.تَقْدِيمِهَا: performing the nawāfil earlier, before the obligatory prayer time fully sets in
key_terms.رَكَعَاتٍ: units of prayer being performed as supererogatory worship
key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun passing the meridian, marking the onset of noon prayer time
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day whose prayer schedule is being discussed

ai.seo_question: Is it better to perform Friday nawāfil before zawāl or after the obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This report discusses the timing of Friday nawāfil and whether some rakʿahs may be performed before the obligatory prayer. The Imam عليه السلام permits advancing six rakʿahs, but states that performing them after the obligatory prayer is more excellent once the time of the farīḍah has entered. The compiler then reconciles the reports by distinguishing between before and after zawāl.
